name: Claude Whiteboards
desc: Shared board where a team brainstorms with Claude
desc_zh: 团队和 Claude 一起头脑风暴的共享白板
solves: Brainstorm notes scatter across chat and docs; a Whiteboard keeps the team's ideas and Claude's suggestions in one place.
solves_zh: 头脑风暴的记录散落在聊天和文档里，白板把大家的想法和 Claude 的建议放在同一处。
best_for: A kickoff call needs a plan by the end of the hour and the room is still arguing about scope.
best_for_zh: 启动会还有一小时就要出方案，屋里还在为范围争论。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 Beta on all paid plans; off by default on Enterprise.
